assertions.assertion: The denial being appealed carries reason code CO-50.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
Atlas determined the service was not medically necessary.
The clinical indication note documents the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness corresponds to diagnosis code R42.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries corresponds to diagnosis code I25.10.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency corresponds to diagnosis code I34.0.
There is an ordering note referenced as the source of the order rationale.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
Reconsideration of the CO-50 determination is being requested (appeal rights exist).
